author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Can you preserve screen-used sci-fi props made of vinyl and PVC? After Battlestar Galactica’s Katee Sackhoff asked about restoring her original Raptor spacesuit on the @KateeSackhoffOfficial show, Adam dives into the tough reality of materials science, archival containment, and why certain movie wardrobe pieces inevitably degrade. Plus, he shares hard-earned advice on a thorny topic: how to handle paid commissions for friends without risking the relationship. With thanks to Tested members erhino62 and donaldforbes8652 for their questions and support! Do YOU have advice or stories about doing business with friends?
